messages.app.title: dwloc editor
messages.server.listening: Listening. Open this URL in your browser.
messages.server.browser_skipped: --no-browser was given. Not opening a browser.
messages.server.browser_failed: Could not open a browser. Paste the URL above instead.
messages.server.editing: You can edit translations. They are saved when you stop typing. publish is not run.
messages.server.save_target: Saved to the working copy when there is one, otherwise to the published file.
messages.server.idle_hint: Stops by itself after {duration} without activity.
messages.server.idle_off: Will not stop by itself when idle (--idle-timeout 0).
messages.error.bad_request: The request has the wrong shape.
messages.error.conflict: The file changed underneath. Nothing was written.
messages.error.save_failed: Could not save. The file was not changed.
messages.error.file_readonly: This file is read-only. It cannot be saved.
messages.error.no_row_saved: Not one row could be saved.
messages.error.row_moved: This row has shifted. A different key now sits on that line number, so nothing was written. Please reload.
messages.warn.value_normalized: The saved value differs from what you typed. The value in the file is shown.
messages.ui.edit_notice: Pick a translation cell to edit it. It is saved when you stop typing. publish is not run. Enter and Escape only close the input; what you typed stays.
messages.ui.save_failed_detail: Could not save. Edit the row again, or reload.
messages.ui.discard_confirm: Some translations are not saved. Reloading drops them. Reload anyway?
messages.ui.conflict_title: The file changed underneath. Your edits are kept.
messages.ui.conflict_help: What was re-read is shown below. Pick which one to keep. Auto-save is paused until you pick. Anything you type while picking is kept either way.
messages.ui.conflict_take_file: Take what is in the file
messages.ui.orphans_title: Some translations no longer have a row to go to. The row left the file, or more rows now share its key. Copy them down, then reload.
messages.ui.orphan_lost: There is no row for this translation in the file.
messages.note.no_source: There is no working copy, so the source column stays empty.
messages.note.counts_local: Counts come from the check at startup. Rows you translated are subtracted from Untranslated, but no other category was judged again. Restart dwloc edit to count again.
messages.note.working_none: No working copy ({path}). Untranslated rows and rows dropped by publish cannot be judged.
messages.note.working_skipped: The working copy was not read ({path}).
messages.note.order_unreadable: The play order could not be read. Rows gone from the script are not judged.
messages.note.old_order_held: Carry-over candidates are not judged ({reason}). No rows here does not mean there is nowhere to carry a translation to.
messages.stats.source_missing: rows whose source is not collected yet
messages.category.locale_gap: Missing here but present in another locale
messages.category.stray_line_id: Line-ID row not in the script
messages.category.script_gap: Dialogue row not in the script
